enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Fortification +100%: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
Superior False Life: This item grants the wearer +40 maximum health.
Damage Reduction 5/-: Reduces all physical damage by 5.
Knight's Loyalty: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +3 artifact bonus to your To-Hit and Damage rolls, and a +3 Insight bonus to Natural Armor.
